quotes.quote: They have been so very helpful in getting my uncle a wheelchair and explains the process of the dreadful paperwork required by him to get that wheelchair.
Jason was so nice and helpful and got me the chair the same day.
Very rude and disrespectful to myself and my insurance provider for no reason ..
